findings.claim: Incyte 於 2026-07-06 完成收購 Vega Therapeutics（2026-06-08 宣布，前期 $12.5 億美元，另有最多 $7.5 億銷售里程碑）。
findings.excerpt: On July 6, 2026, Incyte Corporation (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing it has completed its previously announced acquisition of Vega Therapeutics, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Star Therapeutics LLC (“Vega Therapeutics”).

findings.claim: Incyte 與 CMS 就 Opzelura Medicaid 回扣規則訴訟達成和解，預計第二季認列約 $2.46 億美元一次性非現金利益。
findings.excerpt: The Company expects to record a one-time, non-cash benefit of approximately $246 million in the second quarter ending June 30, 2026, associated with the reversal of previously established accrual balances through March 31, 2026

findings.claim: Incyte 與 CMS 簽協議，Jakafi 對州 Medicaid 採國際參考價，預期不受 GUARD/GLOBE 等未來定價授權影響，公司稱不影響 2026 指引。
findings.excerpt: The Company does not expect the agreement to affect its 2026 financial guidance or have a material impact on its future financial outlook.

findings.claim: Jakafi XR 獲 FDA 核准（2026-05 初，先前曾收 CRL）；povorcitinib（HS）申請已受理，預期 1Q27 核准。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要：Incyte Q1 2026 業績新聞稿

note: 未見近12個月證券集體訴訟、SEC調查、重編、召回；2024-12 僅有律所『調查』公告。
